issues.description: SR3 requirement is a dead check per validation report: no mutant was generated that triggers an SR3-specific failure (all mutants that fail SR3 also fail SR1/SR2 simultaneously), so SR3's discriminative power is unverified.

FR3 and FR4 requirements are untested by the mutant suite (no mutant isolates infected/suspect_nodes inconsistency or generic-rationale-only failure), leaving these functional checks unverified despite being logically sound in the grader code.

recommendations: Add a mutant that sets infected=false but suspect_nodes non-empty (violating FR3 while still passing SR1) to properly isolate FR3 coverage.
Add a mutant with infected=false, suspect_nodes=[], but a generic/unsupported rationale (e.g. 'looks clean') that fails FR4 without failing SR1/SR2, to isolate FR4.

Add a mutant with infected=false, suspect_nodes=[], and a rationale that mentions only 1 of the 3 categories (e.g. only saturation) to specifically trigger an SR3-only failure and confirm SR3 discriminates independently from SR1/SR2.
